result.text:
I made all three improvements. All 14 tests passed before the changes, and all 14 still pass after them.

**1. Duplication in tests 2 and 3.** Both tests now use a new check, `assertSalesMadeTo:areOnlyOne:`, which asserts that a customer has exactly one sale and that it is the given product. I also moved the line that creates the sales system (`salesSystem := CoffeeShopSalesSystem new`), which every test repeated, into `setUp`.

**2. Duplication in the last 6 tests.** Each of the six is now a single call to `assertRewardOf:afterBuying:is:of:at:`. It registers the purchases, gets the reward and checks its quantity, product and price. The two sets of purchases are named `productsHoldingRule1` (Combo1 + Combo2) and `productsHoldingRule2` (Combo1 + Combo1 + Combo2).

**3. `if`s replaced by polymorphism.**
- **Products:** there are new classes `CoffeeShopProduct`, `Combo1` and `Combo2`. Each product answers its own `price` and `volume`, so I removed `CoffeeShopSalesSystem>>volumeOf:` and `RewardRule>>priceOf:`. Two products are equal when they are of the same class.
- **Customer types:** there are new classes `CoffeeShopCustomerType`, `GoldCustomerType`, `SilverCustomerType` and `NormalCustomerType`. Each type knows its reward prices: `combo1RewardPrice` (75, 83 or 97 pesos) and `combo2RewardPriceOf:` (1/2, 3/4 or 9/10 of the product's price).
- **Reward rules:** `createRewardFor:` is now written once, in `RewardRule`. It asks the subclass for the product, the quantity and `rewardPriceFor:`, and each subclass hands that question to the customer's type. This also removed the two near-identical `createRewardFor:` methods and the unused `product` variable.
- **Rewards:** `CoffeeShopReward` now has `isFor: aProduct` in place of `isForCombo1` and `isForCombo2`.

**Changes that affect the rest of the code:**
- **Customers and products are objects now, not symbols.** In the tests, customers are created with `GoldCustomerType new` instead of `#Gold`, and `combo1` and `combo2` answer `Combo1 new` and `Combo2 new`. Any other code that still passes `#Gold` or `#Combo1` will break.
- **`CoffeeShopTest` has moved.** It was in `IngSof1-2019-2C-1Parcial` and is now in `IngSof1-2019-2C-1Parcial-Tests`, as you asked. All the new model classes are in `IngSof1-2019-2C-1Parcial`.

The changes are only in the running image: I haven't saved the image or written out any package.
